authority: CANDIDATE CONDITIONAL ANALYTICAL STUDY; NOT APPROVED HARDWARE LIMITS
status: No simulator, native or hardware execution; preserve source topology
state_scope: A/B values are local buffered voltages relative to a lumped jack AGND; nominal ideal linear follower assumptions. Open/bridge are hypothetical transition states, not guaranteed switch dwell or sequencing. External input pulldown calculation assumes corresponding protected input equals buffered voltage; Ron, offset, leakage and clamps remain separate.
resistance_scope: Two mated GH contacts per return branch; four per complete signal. Extra copper/wire/common values are sensitivity proposals, not extracted or guaranteed bounds. No equal sharing or opposing-current cancellation credited. 0.5mohm applies only to the explicitly hypothetical upstream-common case, never the GH branch.
ground_target_scope: Retained planning comparison, not a newly approved universal X1 requirement or a measured failure threshold. Do not silently relax it or equate every ground shift to unity output error.

ADG5412F_primary_ground_evidence.locator: Table1 continuation, POWER REQUIREMENTS, Normal Mode and Fault Mode, IGND
ADG5412F_primary_ground_evidence.conditions: VDD=+16.5V,VSS=-16.5V,GND=0V; digital inputs0V,5V orVDD. Full-temperature maximum column -40..125C. Fault mode VS=+/-55V. These are not guaranteed bounds at project+/-12V or arbitrary startup states.
ADG5412F_primary_ground_evidence.use_in_analysis: Direct IGND row avoids inferring package ground current from independent IDD/ISS maxima. Applying these values at project rails is explicitly a sensitivity assumption, not manufacturer qualification.

dynamic_sensitivities.scope: Numerical proposal cases only; actual capacitance, slew, displacement-current destination, supply sequencing and unallocated board bulk remain UNKNOWN. No simulation.
